a1-unit-30.30.1 Kitchen:
Narrator: It's Saturday morning in São Paulo. Ana's parents are coming for lunch tomorrow. Ana and Marcos are checking the kitchen before they go to the supermarket.
Ana: So, what can we cook for my parents tomorrow? My mom loves lasagna.
Marcos: Lasagna is a lot of work! Let's check the kitchen first and make a list.
Ana: OK. Do we have any pasta?
Marcos: No, we don't have any pasta. But we have a lot of rice and some beans.
Ana: What about meat? Do we have any chicken?
Marcos: Yes, there's some chicken in the freezer. It's enough for five people.
Ana: Great! And vegetables? Do we have any onions and garlic?
Marcos: We have an onion, but we don't have any garlic. I'm writing garlic on the list.
Ana: We need some tomatoes and a lettuce for the salad too.
Marcos: Right. Your dad loves cheese bread. Do we have any cheese?
Ana: No, there isn't any cheese, so let's buy some. Oh, and there isn't any coffee! We drink a lot of coffee in this house.
Marcos: OK, so no lasagna. Chicken with rice and beans, a big salad, and cheese bread with coffee after lunch.
Ana: Perfect! A real Brazilian Sunday lunch. Let's go!
